sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Crystal Floral Vine Cluster Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent: Illuminate your neckline with this radiant crystal floral necklace. Featuring a dainty gold-toned chain and a brilliant vine of shimmering marquise-cut crystals, this anti-tarnish piece offers a high-end, sophisticated sparkle. It is the perfect elegant accessory for weddings, special events, or adding a touch of luxury to your daily style
